svg.title: Fictional 15-acre Containers Hamlet woodland site plan
svg.desc: Fictional 15-acre (6.07 ha) wooded parcel drawn to scale in metres, north up. Heron Lake lies along the west boundary, with a beaver meadow wetland in the south and two seasonal drainage channels. Rock outcrops, mixed woodland, natural clearings and small building benches are shown. Hatched no-build zones show a 30 m shoreline setback and a 30 m wetland buffer (placeholder values). One entrance from the east leads to shared parking, an accessible drop-off and the lodge. A narrow emergency, construction and maintenance track loops through the woods; walking paths serve each home. Views: Cedar faces 259° toward the lake; Birch faces 157° toward birch-glade; Pine faces 287° toward the lake; Moss faces 209° toward the wet meadow; Fern faces 270° toward the lake; Juniper faces 271° toward the lake; Lodge faces 279° toward gathering-glade. Buildings: Cabin A, Cedar (permanent, 52.8 m from the shoreline); Cabin B, Birch (permanent, 148.1 m from the shoreline); Cabin C, Pine (permanent, 95.7 m from the shoreline); Cabin D, Moss (seasonal, 178.8 m from the shoreline); Cabin E, Fern (community rental, 161 m from the shoreline); Cabin F, Juniper (seasonal, 45.8 m from the shoreline); Common lodge, Lodge (shared, 196.9 m from the shoreline). Not surveyed; not for construction.

g.text: Original concept | CC BY 4.0 | Containers Hamlet contributors 2026 | Fictional site; contours, buffers, benches and positions are illustrative
